deploy-bot: :rocket: Starting deploy to `dev-sbx`
env: dev-sbx
tag: release/v1.14.0-rc3-hotfix
commit: 4f3b2a7
owner: @alex_m
change-window: immediate (low-traffic)
notes: https://go/redwood/releases/1.14.0-rc3
flags: --no-migrate --ff=feature/new-rerank

alex_m: ack, I'll watch smoke and pin model if needed. kicking off preflight now.

sara: quick heads-up — test infra currently expecting model v2.3.1 pinned on dev-sbx. if the rollout uses v2.4 it will fail some canaries. can we pin?

alex_m: good catch. adding model_pin: v2.3.1 to rollout config now:
```
rollout:
  strategy: phased
  phases: [10, 50, 100]
  model_pin: v2.3.1
```

taylor: FYI load test for infra-team at 11:30. try to keep changes incremental. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed (image checksum OK, nodes available). Starting phase 1 (10%).

deploy-bot: Smoke tests: 4/5 OK, 1 failing — rerank integration timeout (500ms > threshold 300ms).
```
[smoke] rerank: POST /v1/rerank -> 500 Timeout
trace: inference-host-07.k8s: request=abcdef, latency=520ms
```

sara: that's the pinned-model interaction — the pinned version is returning slower for this specific route. we should pause before going to 50%.

eng-release-coordinator: Request: pause rollout at 10% and investigate. If a quick revert is available, rollback to `release/v1.13.2` for dev-sbx to keep test cadence.

alex_m: pausing rollout now. I'll try a config tweak (increase rerank timeout for smoke only) but if that doesn't clear in 10m we rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at phase 1 (10%). Traffic unchanged. Recorded pause reason: rerank-timeout-on-pinned-model.

alex_m: temp patch applied to smoke suite to extend timeout to 800ms. re-running smoke subset.

deploy-bot: Smoke tests re-run: 5/5 OK. latency improved to ~230ms after pin config fallback.

sara: thanks — but we should still be cautious. re-run full integration in staging tomorrow. for now keep model_pin in place.

taylor: good call. I'll reschedule the load test by 30m.

eng-release-coordinator: Proceed to phase 2 (50%) supervised. keep a 15m watch and auto-rollback on error spike >2x baseline.

deploy-bot: Phase 2 started. 50% traffic. Canary metrics look steady (err=0.2%, baseline=0.15%).

deploy-bot: Phase 3 started. 100% traffic.

eng-release-coordinator: Confirming final status — deploy complete to `dev-sbx` tag `release/v1.14.0-rc3-hotfix` commit `4f3b2a7`. No rollback performed.

alex_m: pushing short release note to the release doc and linking to follow-up issue for model perf: https://go/redwood/issue/INF-1423

sara: added note: "model v2.3.1 temporarily pinned due to rerank latency on dev-sbx; follow-up to evaluate v2.4 performance and adjust rollout flags."

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Deploy finished at ts=2419001305. artifacts: image://gcr/redwood/infra:1.14.0-rc3-hotfix, rollout-log=https://go/redwood/logs/2419001234

eng-release-coordinator: Great job. reminder: rollouts to sandbox/prod will require separate windows and an explicit no-pin decision.

alex_m: noted. I'll open a PR to remove the model pin once we validate v2.4 in staging.

sara: thanks all :tada:
